panels.title: ПОЧАСОВОЙ тренд средней |ошибки|, м — сглаженный взгляд (сюда смотреть за трендами; минутные панели ниже шумят по природе)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (atMs/3600000)*3600 AS time, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "naive", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "schedule", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "engine-live", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "learned", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "learned-fast", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "learned-2h", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "ml-mlp" FROM scores WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY atMs/3600000 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT (atMs/3600000)*3600 AS time, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "naive", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "schedule", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "engine-live", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "learned", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "learned-fast", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "learned-2h", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN absErrM END),1) AS "ml-mlp" FROM scores WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY atMs/3600000 ORDER BY time

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN meanAbs END) AS "naive", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN meanAbs END) AS "schedule", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN meanAbs END) AS "engine-live", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-smooth' THEN meanAbs END) AS "engine-smooth", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN meanAbs END) AS "learned", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN meanAbs END) AS "learned-fast", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN meanAbs END) AS "learned-2h", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN meanAbs END) AS "ml-gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN meanAbs END) AS "ml-mlp" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY tsMin
targets.queryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN meanAbs END) AS "naive", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN meanAbs END) AS "schedule", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN meanAbs END) AS "engine-live", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-smooth' THEN meanAbs END) AS "engine-smooth", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN meanAbs END) AS "learned", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN meanAbs END) AS "learned-fast", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN meanAbs END) AS "learned-2h", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN meanAbs END) AS "ml-gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN meanAbs END) AS "ml-mlp" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY tsMin

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p90Abs END) AS "naive", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN p90Abs END) AS "schedule", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN p90Abs END) AS "engine-live", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN p90Abs END) AS "learned", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN p90Abs END) AS "learned-fast", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN p90Abs END) AS "learned-2h", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p90Abs END) AS "ml-gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN p90Abs END) AS "ml-mlp" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY tsMin

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT variant, CASE WHEN horizonS<30 THEN '1) <30s' WHEN horizonS<60 THEN '2) 30-60s' WHEN horizonS<120 THEN '3) 60-120s' ELSE '4) 120s+' END AS horizon, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(absErrM),1) AS mean_abs_m, ROUND(AVG(errM),1) AS bias_m FROM scores WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY variant, horizon ORDER BY horizon, mean_abs_m
targets.queryText: SELECT variant, CASE WHEN horizonS<30 THEN '1) <30s' WHEN horizonS<60 THEN '2) 30-60s' WHEN horizonS<120 THEN '3) 60-120s' ELSE '4) 120s+' END AS horizon, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(absErrM),1) AS mean_abs_m, ROUND(AVG(errM),1) AS bias_m FROM scores WHERE atMs BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY variant, horizon ORDER BY horizon, mean_abs_m

panels.title: Знаковая ошибка (bias), м — плюс = предсказание впереди реальности

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN signedMean END) AS "naive", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN signedMean END) AS "schedule", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN signedMean END) AS "engine-live", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN signedMean END) AS "learned", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN signedMean END) AS "learned-fast", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN signedMean END) AS "learned-2h", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN signedMean END) AS "ml-gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN signedMean END) AS "ml-mlp" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY tsMin
targets.queryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN signedMean END) AS "naive", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN signedMean END) AS "schedule", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN signedMean END) AS "engine-live", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN signedMean END) AS "learned", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN signedMean END) AS "learned-fast", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN signedMean END) AS "learned-2h", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN signedMean END) AS "ml-gbdt", MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN signedMean END) AS "ml-mlp" FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY tsMin

panels.title: Улучшение p50 относительно naive, % (выше = лучше; ГЛАВНЫЙ график гипотез)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, ROUND(100.0*(nv-sc)/nv,1) AS "schedule", ROUND(100.0*(nv-el)/nv,1) AS "engine-live", ROUND(100.0*(nv-l)/nv,1) AS "learned", ROUND(100.0*(nv-lf)/nv,1) AS "learned-fast", ROUND(100.0*(nv-l2)/nv,1) AS "learned-2h", ROUND(100.0*(nv-g)/nv,1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(100.0*(nv-m)/nv,1) AS "ml-mlp" FROM (SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p50Abs END) AS nv, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN p50Abs END) AS sc, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN p50Abs END) AS el, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN p50Abs END) AS l, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN p50Abs END) AS lf, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN p50Abs END) AS l2, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p50Abs END) AS g, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN p50Abs END) AS m FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY tsMin) WHERE nv > 0 ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT time, ROUND(100.0*(nv-sc)/nv,1) AS "schedule", ROUND(100.0*(nv-el)/nv,1) AS "engine-live", ROUND(100.0*(nv-l)/nv,1) AS "learned", ROUND(100.0*(nv-lf)/nv,1) AS "learned-fast", ROUND(100.0*(nv-l2)/nv,1) AS "learned-2h", ROUND(100.0*(nv-g)/nv,1) AS "ml-gbdt", ROUND(100.0*(nv-m)/nv,1) AS "ml-mlp" FROM (SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='naive' THEN p50Abs END) AS nv, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='schedule' THEN p50Abs END) AS sc, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='engine-live' THEN p50Abs END) AS el, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned' THEN p50Abs END) AS l, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-fast' THEN p50Abs END) AS lf, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='learned-2h' THEN p50Abs END) AS l2, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-gbdt' THEN p50Abs END) AS g, MAX(CASE WHEN variant='ml-mlp' THEN p50Abs END) AS m FROM rollup_minute WHERE hbucket='all' AND tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY tsMin) WHERE nv > 0 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Обучение: сколько ячеек выучено (растёт с данными)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, segCells AS "скоростные ячейки (участок×время)", stopDwellCells AS "стоянки остановок", stopReleaseCells AS "время отпускания", paceSamples AS "всего скоростных замеров" FROM rollup_learning WHERE tsMin*60000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY tsMin

panels.title: ML: MAE на holdout по тренировкам, м (вся история)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tsMin*60 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN model='gbdt' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "LightGBM", MAX(CASE WHEN model='mlp' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "нейросеть (MLP)", MAX(CASE WHEN model='naive_ds0' THEN maeHoldout END) AS "naive (стоит на месте)" FROM ml_train_log GROUP BY tsMin ORDER BY tsMin
